SessionRunnerLLM control operations
|
|-- drain(input): one borrowed-graph invocation, not the execution owner
|   |-- Local boundary state: force, continuing, step, entering, stepped
|   |-- Startup -> await plugin activation; settle stale compactions/tool calls
|   `-- advanceToStep (closure over this drain's boundary state)
|       |-- Location closed -> close transport; return Reloaded
|       |-- -> SessionInbox: inspect eligible durable work under serialization
|       |   |-- Move -> deliver control + publish Moved; return Moved
|       |   `-- Manual compaction -> deliver marker; select/preview; compact
|       |-- Input boundary -> prepareContext; promote eligible inbox items
|       |   |-- Queued prompts at turn boundaries; steer during continuation
|       |   |-- Promoted top-level untitled input -> titles FiberMap
|       |   |   `-- -> SessionTitle.generate (does not block the model)
|       |   `-- -> SessionContext.load -> runStep; advance local step counter
|       `-- No work -> idle hook after model work; recheck inbox or Complete
|-- prepareContext(sessionID)
|   `-- -> plugin activation; SessionContext.select; InstructionState.prepare
`-- runStep(loaded, step): logical step policy
    |-- Local assistant ID, retry helper and recovery guards
    |-- Attempt loop
    |   |-- Retry -> reload context without promoting more inbox input
    |   |-- -> SessionCompaction: estimate / auto compact / precompute
    |   |   `-- Completed compaction -> new assistant ID and reload history
    |   |-- baseTranscript -> context.request.primary
    |   |   |-- History + instructions + agent/model + selected tools
    |   |   `-- Step limit -> toolChoice none; keep definitions for caching
    |   `-- -> SessionStep.attempt(prepared request, retry/recovery callbacks)
    `-- Outcome handling
        |-- Completed -> continue or finish; idle precompute when finished
        |-- Retry -> wait/backoff; optionally allocate fresh assistant ID
        |-- Compacted / RecoverFull -> guarded retry with refreshed context
        `-- OutputLimit -> bounded continuation; synthetic instruction if needed
